title: Human Cell
summary: Explore the microscopic anatomy of the human cell, including the nucleus, mitochondria, and cell membrane.
focus: Cell membrane, nucleus, mitochondria (ATP), endoplasmic reticulum, and ribosomes.

cues.text: Qrie AI ki is demo class mein aapka swagat hai! Har human cell ek flexible aur selective cell membrane se surrounded hoti hai.
Andar nutrient-rich cytoplasm hota hai, ek protective jelly jo har vital organelle ko fibrous network mein suspend karti hai.
Board par hamara dynamic human cell dekhiye, jo hamare living tissues ke andar pure flexibility ke saath bana hai.
Center mein nucleus hai, master control library jisme saare genetic DNA instructions nuclear pores ke andar safely stored rehte hain.
Nucleus ke aas-paas oval mitochondria hain, cell ke powerhouses jo oxygen aur glucose se life-giving ATP energy generate karte hain.
In folded cristae ko dekhiye jo surface area badhate hain, aur heart aur muscle cells ko har millisecond uninterrupted power dete hain.
Nucleus ke charon taraf in ribbon channels ko dekhiye. Kaun sa organelle genetic instructions se naye proteins synthesize karta hai?
Yahan pause karke in folded membranes ko dekhiye aur sochiye ki organelles aapas mein kaise coordinate karte hain.
Ye tiny specks ribosomes hain, aur surrounding highway rough endoplasmic reticulum hai, jo amino acid chains ko functional proteins mein assemble karti hai.
Golgi apparatus in ready proteins ko vesicles mein pack aur address karke deliver karta hai, aur manufacturing line complete hoti hai.
Ye saare specialized organelle systems perfectly coordinate karte hain, aur trillions of human cells mein life sustain karte hain.
Neurons ki firing se lekar muscles ke contraction tak, ye cellular teamwork human body ko dynamically chalati hai.
Qrie AI ki ye demo class yahan complete hoti hai! Apne notes aur questions review kijiye, milte hain next class mein!

notes.title: The nucleus commands and protects DNA
notes.text: The nucleus is enclosed by a double-layered nuclear envelope with pores regulating transport. Inside, DNA stores the master genetic blueprint for synthesizing all proteins required by the human body.

notes.title: Mitochondria generate cellular fuel
notes.text: Through cellular respiration, mitochondria break down glucose in the presence of oxygen to synthesize adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the primary energy currency utilized across all cellular metabolic processes.

notes.title: Protein production pipeline: Ribosomes to Golgi
notes.text: Ribosomes bound to the rough endoplasmic reticulum assemble amino acid chains. The synthesized proteins travel to the Golgi apparatus, where they undergo folding, biochemical modification, and vesicular packaging.

mistake: Don’t confuse human cells with plant cells. Human cells me flexible cell membrane aur active mitochondria hote hain, lekin inme rigid plant cell walls ya chloroplasts nahi hote.

practice.question: Why do active muscle cells contain substantially higher concentrations of mitochondria than skin cells?
practice.answer: Muscle cells continuously contract and require high quantities of ATP energy, which mitochondria produce via aerobic cellular respiration to power muscular exertion.
